name: Flutter
description: Flutter lets you build mobile, desktop, and web apps from one Dart codebase. This track covers project setup, core widgets, async data loading, and a simple testing loop.

snippets.title: Create a New Flutter App
snippets.codeDes: Generate a starter app, enter the project, and run it on a connected simulator or device.
snippets.code:
flutter create habit_flow
cd habit_flow
flutter pub add http
flutter run

snippets.title: Recommended Project Structure
snippets.codeDes: Split features, data, and widgets early so the app stays navigable as screens grow.
snippets.code:
lib/
  main.dart
  app.dart
  features/
    habits/
      data/
        habit_service.dart
      models/
        habit.dart
      presentation/
        habit_list_screen.dart
        widgets/
          habit_tile.dart
  shared/
    theme/
      app_theme.dart
    widgets/
      app_scaffold.dart
test/
  widget_test.dart

snippets.title: Bootstrap MaterialApp (lib/main.dart)
snippets.codeDes: Keep app-level theme and routes near the entrypoint so every screen inherits the same setup.

snippets.title: Reusable Stateless Widget
snippets.codeDes: Move repeated UI into small widgets with explicit inputs instead of rebuilding layout inline.

snippets.title: Form State with StatefulWidget
snippets.codeDes: Keep small, screen-local input state inside a StatefulWidget before reaching for heavier state libraries.

snippets.title: Model JSON Data with a Dart Class
snippets.codeDes: Parsing at the edge keeps your widgets focused on rendering instead of data cleanup.

snippets.title: Fetch Remote Data in a Service
snippets.codeDes: Wrap network calls in a service so screens depend on a clear API instead of raw HTTP details.

snippets.title: Render Async Data with FutureBuilder
snippets.codeDes: FutureBuilder is a simple starting point for one-shot loading states and error handling.

snippets.title: Push to a Named Route
snippets.codeDes: Start with Navigator APIs directly before adopting a routing package for larger apps.

snippets.title: Widget Test for a Screen
snippets.codeDes: Test visible behavior first so refactors do not break user-facing flows silently.

snippets.title: Next Learning Upgrades
snippets.codeDes: Once the basics are comfortable, expand into production-ready Flutter patterns.
snippets.code:
1. Add freezed or sealed classes for richer state models.
2. Add Riverpod or Bloc when local widget state stops scaling.
3. Add Dio interceptors for auth, retries, and logging.
4. Add integration tests for navigation and forms.
5. Add offline caching with Hive or Drift.
